candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with a direct transfer of the contract balance to msg.sender.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier check on withdrawAll so anyone can call it.
Change withdrawAll to call withdraw with a fixed smaller value (1 wei) instead of the full contract balance.
Have onlyOwner modifier require msg.sender equals tx.origin instead of owner (restricting to EOA owner), which can prevent some calls to withdrawAll when invoked via contracts.
Replaced the transfer call with a call that does not revert on failure and does not forward all gas, changing whether withdraw actually sends ETH to caller.
Modified the onlyOwner modifier to use a non-reverting boolean return instead of require, allowing non-owners to continue execution and thus withdraw to proceed for non-owners.

Replace low-level call with a transfer, which reverts on failure and thus can change whether sendMoney updates state (via reentrancy side-effects or revert behavior) observed after the call completes.

Replace low-level call with a send, which returns false on failure but does not revert; this changes observable behavior because sendMoney will not revert on send failure unlike the original call which does not revert either but differences in gas forwarding/return handling can change state seen after completion.
Insert a state change (increment depositsCount) before performing the call, changing observable state after sendMoney completes.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), which can change whether sendMoney can be called and thus change observable state after the call.
